question: The Mussalman Wakf (Repeal) Bill, 2025, seeks to remove the outdated Mussalman Wakf Act of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1923**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mussalman Wakf (Repeal) Bill, 2025**, has been proposed to officially remove the **Mussalman Wakf Act, 1923** (Act No. 42 of 1923), from the Indian legal system.
 
• The **Mussalman Wakf Act, 1923**, was a colonial-era legislation enacted during the **British Raj** with the primary objective of ensuring better management of **Wakf properties** and mandatory auditing of their accounts.
 
• The 1923 Act required **Mutawallis** (managers of Waqf) to furnish statements of particulars and annual accounts to the **District Court**, ensuring a degree of financial transparency.
 
• The repeal of this **102-year-old law** is part of the **Government of India’s** broader legislative cleanup drive to abolish **obsolete and redundant laws** that have lost their relevance due to subsequent modern enactments.
 
• The provisions of the 1923 Act have been effectively superseded by more comprehensive legislations, such as the **Waqf Act, 1954**, and the currently prevailing Waqf
